usages.explain:
Used in conversations between close individuals to emphasize the speaker's argument, especially when the speaker is concerned that the other party does not understand their point.
Used in conversations among individuals with close relationships.

examples.content: ニヤニヤするのはやめろってば！
examples.transcription: にやにやするのはやめろってば！

examples.content: はやく勉強しなさいってば。ねえ、聞こえないの？
examples.transcription: はやくべんきょうしなさいってば。ねえ、きこえないの？
examples.mean: I want you to study quickly. Hey, can't you hear me?

examples.transcription: りょうかいしたってば。

title: ってば => Speaking of; I told you already
